build_rag_qa_chain: build a retrieval augmented generation QA chain with LangChain, Milvus vector store, and vLLM chat model
run_rag_cli: run the RAG CLI script with vLLM embedding and chat endpoints to answer questions from a web document
load_split_documents: load and split documents from a web URL using RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter with configurable chunk size and overlap
init_vectorstore_milvus: initialize a Milvus vector store with OpenAI-compatible embeddings from a list of LangChain documents
init_vllm_chat_llm: initialize a ChatOpenAI LLM configured to connect to a vLLM-compatible chat endpoint
